properties.description: YumaAIA-D04-HighRiskGraphPermission Analytics Rule with template version 1.0.0

Detects when a high-risk Microsoft Graph application or delegated permission is granted to an Entra agent identity, an AI-named service principal, or self-granted by an application. Suppresses service principals listed in the YumaAIRegisterApproved watchlist. Maps to ISM-2156, ISM-2137, ISM-2138 and ISM-2139.
properties.displayName: Yuma AIA-D04 High-risk Graph permission granted to AI agent or AI app
properties.query:
let lookback = 1h;
let AllowedAppIds = _GetWatchlist("YumaAIRegisterApproved") | project SearchKey;   // approved in the AI register
let HighRiskPermissions = dynamic([
    "Application.ReadWrite.All", "AppRoleAssignment.ReadWrite.All", "Directory.ReadWrite.All",
    "AgentIdentity.ReadWrite.All", "DelegatedPermissionGrant.ReadWrite.All",
    "RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory", "User.ReadWrite.All", "Group.ReadWrite.All",
    "Policy.ReadWrite.ConditionalAccess", "Mail.Read", "Mail.ReadWrite", "Mail.Send",
    "MailboxSettings.ReadWrite", "full_access_as_app", "EWS.AccessAsUser.All",
    "Files.Read.All", "Files.ReadWrite.All", "Sites.Read.All", "Sites.ReadWrite.All",
    "Sites.FullControl.All", "Chat.Read.All", "Chat.ReadWrite.All", "ChannelMessage.Read.All"]);
let AIKeywords = dynamic(["openai", "chatgpt", "anthropic", "claude", "copilot", "gemini", "perplexity",
    "deepseek", "mistral", "grok", "otter", "fireflies", "n8n", "zapier", "langchain", "cursor"]);
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where LoggedByService =~ "Core Directory" and Category =~ "ApplicationManagement"
| where OperationName in~ ("Add app role assignment to service principal", "Consent to application",
                           "Add delegated permission grant")
| where Result =~ "success"
| mv-apply TargetResource = TargetResources on (
      where tostring(TargetResource.type) =~ "ServicePrincipal"
      | extend TargetSpId = tostring(TargetResource.id),
               TargetSpName = tostring(TargetResource.displayName),
               TargetAgentType = tostring(TargetResource.agentType),
               Props = TargetResource.modifiedProperties
      | take 1)
| mv-apply Prop = Props on (
      summarize Bag = make_bag(bag_pack(tostring(Prop.displayName), trim(@'[\"\s]+', tostring(Prop.newValue))), 100))
| extend GrantedPermissions = strcat(tostring(Bag["AppRole.Value"]), " ", tostring(Bag["ConsentAction.Permissions"]),
                                     " ", tostring(Bag["DelegatedPermissionGrant.Scope"]))
// For app role assignments the client app sits in modifiedProperties; for consent it is the target SP.
| extend ClientAppName = iff(isnotempty(tostring(Bag["ServicePrincipal.DisplayName"])), tostring(Bag["ServicePrincipal.DisplayName"]), TargetSpName),
         ClientSpId = iff(isnotempty(tostring(Bag["ServicePrincipal.ObjectID"])), tostring(Bag["ServicePrincipal.ObjectID"]), TargetSpId),
         IsAdminConsent = tostring(Bag["ConsentContext.IsAdminConsent"])
| extend MatchedPermissions = set_intersect(extract_all(@"([A-Za-z_]+(?:\.[A-Za-z]+)+|full_access_as_app)", GrantedPermissions), HighRiskPermissions)
| where array_length(MatchedPermissions) > 0
| where ClientSpId !in (AllowedAppIds)
| extend InitiatorAgentType = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.agentType)
| extend IsAgentic = (isnotempty(TargetAgentType) and TargetAgentType !~ "notAgentic")
                     or (isnotempty(InitiatorAgentType) and InitiatorAgentType !~ "notAgentic"),
         IsAINamed = ClientAppName has_any (AIKeywords) or ClientAppName matches regex @"(?i)\b(ai|gpt|llm|mcp|agent|bot)\b",
         IsSelfGrantByApp = isnotempty(tostring(InitiatedBy.app.servicePrincipalId))
| where IsAgentic or IsAINamed or IsSelfGrantByApp
| extend InitiatedByUpn = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
         InitiatedByApp = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName),
         InitiatedByIp = iff(isnotempty(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)), tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.ipAddress))
| extend Severity = case(MatchedPermissions has_any ("RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory", "Application.ReadWrite.All", "AppRoleAssignment.ReadWrite.All", "Directory.ReadWrite.All", "AgentIdentity.ReadWrite.All"), "High",
                         IsAgentic, "High",
                         "Medium")
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, ClientAppName, ClientSpId, TargetAgentType, IsAgentic, IsAINamed, IsSelfGrantByApp,
          MatchedPermissions, GrantedPermissions, IsAdminConsent, InitiatedByUpn, InitiatedByApp, InitiatedByIp,
          Severity, CorrelationId

properties.description: YumaAIA-D05-NewAIAppConsent Analytics Rule with template version 1.0.0

Detects first-seen admin or user OAuth consent to an Entra agent identity or AI-named application. Approved service principals in the YumaAIRegisterApproved watchlist are suppressed unless consent is granted by a non-admin user. Maps to ISM-2134, ISM-2135, ISM-2137, ISM-2138 and ISM-2139.
properties.displayName: Yuma AIA-D05 New AI app consent (user or admin), first seen
properties.query:
let lookback = 1h;
let baseline = 30d;
let AIKeywords = dynamic(["openai", "chatgpt", "anthropic", "claude", "copilot", "gemini", "perplexity",
    "deepseek", "mistral", "grok", "otter", "fireflies", "read.ai", "n8n", "zapier", "langchain",
    "cursor", "notion ai", "jasper", "writer", "poe", "character.ai", "huggingface"]);
let Consents = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(baseline)
    | where LoggedByService =~ "Core Directory" and Category =~ "ApplicationManagement"
    | where OperationName =~ "Consent to application" and Result =~ "success"
    | mv-apply TargetResource = TargetResources on (
          where tostring(TargetResource.type) =~ "ServicePrincipal"
          | extend AppSpId = tostring(TargetResource.id),
                   AppName = tostring(TargetResource.displayName),
                   AppAgentType = tostring(TargetResource.agentType),
                   Props = TargetResource.modifiedProperties
          | take 1)
    | mv-apply Prop = Props on (
          summarize Bag = make_bag(bag_pack(tostring(Prop.displayName), trim(@'[\"\s]+', tostring(Prop.newValue))), 100));
let Approved = _GetWatchlist("YumaAIRegisterApproved") | project SearchKey;
let PreviouslySeen = Consents
    | where TimeGenerated <= ago(lookback)
    | distinct AppSpId;
Consents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| extend IsAdminConsent = tostring(Bag["ConsentContext.IsAdminConsent"]),
         ConsentAction = tostring(Bag["ConsentAction.Permissions"])
| parse ConsentAction with * "ConsentType: " ConsentType ", Scope: " Scopes "," *
| extend IsAgentic = isnotempty(AppAgentType) and AppAgentType !~ "notAgentic",
         IsAINamed = AppName has_any (AIKeywords) or AppName matches regex @"(?i)\b(ai|gpt|llm|mcp|agent|copilot)\b",
         IsFirstSeen = AppSpId !in (PreviouslySeen),
         IsUserConsent = IsAdminConsent =~ "False"
| where IsAgentic or IsAINamed
| where IsFirstSeen or IsUserConsent
| where AppSpId !in (Approved) or IsUserConsent
| extend ConsentedByUpn = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
         ConsentedByIp = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
| extend Severity = iff(IsUserConsent, "Medium", "Low"),
         RegisterAction = "Create or update ISM-2135 register entry; schedule ISM-2138 review in 6 months"
| project TimeGenerated, AppName, AppSpId, AppAgentType, IsAgentic, IsAINamed, IsFirstSeen, IsUserConsent,
          ConsentType, Scopes, ConsentedByUpn, ConsentedByIp, Severity, RegisterAction, CorrelationId

properties.description: YumaAIA-D07-AgentIdentitySignInAnomaly Analytics Rule with template version 1.0.0

Detects an Entra agent identity or AI service principal signing in from a new ASN or IP, to a new resource, with a new credential type, or with a burst of failures compared to its 14-day baseline. Maps to ISM-2133, ISM-2136, ISM-2141, ISM-2142 and ISM-2148.
properties.displayName: Yuma AIA-D07 Agent identity or AI service principal sign-in anomaly
properties.query:
let lookback = 14d;
let recent = 1h;
let FailureThreshold = 20;
let AIKeywords = dynamic(["openai", "chatgpt", "anthropic", "claude", "copilot", "gemini", "perplexity",
    "deepseek", "mistral", "grok", "n8n", "zapier", "langchain", "agent", "mcp"]);
let AgentSignIns = AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | extend AgentInfo = parse_json(Agent)
    | extend AgentType = tostring(AgentInfo.agentType),
             ParentAppId = tostring(AgentInfo.parentAppId)
    | extend IsAgentic = isnotempty(AgentType) and AgentType !~ "notAgentic"
    | where IsAgentic or ServicePrincipalName has_any (AIKeywords)
    | extend Succeeded = ResultType == "0" or ResultType =~ "Success";
let Baseline = AgentSignIns
    | where TimeGenerated <= ago(recent) and Succeeded
    | summarize KnownIPs = make_set(IPAddress, 1000),
                KnownASNs = make_set(AutonomousSystemNumber, 500),
                KnownResources = make_set(ResourceDisplayName, 500),
                KnownCredTypes = make_set(ClientCredentialType, 20),
                BaselineSignIns = count()
             by ServicePrincipalId;
AgentSignIns
| where TimeGenerated > ago(recent)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            SuccessCount = countif(Succeeded), FailureCount = countif(not(Succeeded)),
            FailureCodes = make_set_if(ResultType, not(Succeeded), 20)
         by ServicePrincipalId, ServicePrincipalName, AppId, AgentType, ParentAppId, IsAgentic,
            IPAddress, AutonomousSystemNumber, ResourceDisplayName, ClientCredentialType
| join kind=leftouter Baseline on ServicePrincipalId
| extend HasBaseline = isnotnull(BaselineSignIns)
| extend NewIP = HasBaseline and SuccessCount > 0 and not(set_has_element(KnownIPs, IPAddress)),
         NewASN = HasBaseline and SuccessCount > 0 and not(set_has_element(KnownASNs, AutonomousSystemNumber)),
         NewResource = HasBaseline and SuccessCount > 0 and not(set_has_element(KnownResources, ResourceDisplayName)),
         NewCredentialType = HasBaseline and SuccessCount > 0 and not(set_has_element(KnownCredTypes, ClientCredentialType)),
         FailureBurst = FailureCount >= FailureThreshold,
         UsesSecret = ClientCredentialType has "secret"   // ISM-2141/2142 prefer managed or certificate credentials
| where NewASN or NewResource or NewCredentialType or FailureBurst or (NewIP and UsesSecret)
| extend Reasons = strcat_array(pack_array(
             iff(NewIP, "new IP", ""), iff(NewASN, "new ASN", ""), iff(NewResource, "new resource", ""),
             iff(NewCredentialType, "new credential type", ""), iff(FailureBurst, "failure burst", ""),
             iff(UsesSecret, "static secret", "")), "; ")
| extend Severity = case((NewASN and NewResource) or FailureBurst, "High", IsAgentic, "Medium", "Low")
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, ServicePrincipalName, ServicePrincipalId, AppId, AgentType, ParentAppId, IsAgentic,
          IPAddress, AutonomousSystemNumber, ResourceDisplayName, ClientCredentialType, SuccessCount, FailureCount,
          FailureCodes, Reasons, Severity

properties.description: YumaAIA-D08-AgentGraphDataAccessBurst Analytics Rule with template version 1.0.0

Detects an AI agent or AI application exceeding its 14-day hourly baseline for sensitive Microsoft Graph API calls across mail, files, SharePoint sites, chats, directory, or Microsoft MCP Server for Enterprise. Maps to ISM-2157 and ISM-2159.
properties.displayName: Yuma AIA-D08 Agent or AI app Microsoft Graph data-access burst
properties.query:
let lookback = 14d;
let recent = 1h;
let MinRequests = 200;        // floor so tiny apps do not alert on noise
let SigmaThreshold = 3.0;
let AIKeywords = dynamic(["openai", "chatgpt", "anthropic", "claude", "copilot", "gemini", "perplexity",
    "deepseek", "mistral", "grok", "n8n", "zapier", "langchain", "agent", "mcp"]);
let AgentApps = AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | extend AgentType = tostring(parse_json(Agent).agentType)
    | where (isnotempty(AgentType) and AgentType !~ "notAgentic") or ServicePrincipalName has_any (AIKeywords)
    | summarize AppName = take_any(ServicePrincipalName), AgentType = take_any(AgentType) by AppId;
let SensitiveCalls = MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where AppId in ((AgentApps | project AppId))
    | extend Path = tolower(tostring(split(RequestUri, "?")[0]))
    | extend Category = case(Path has "/enterprise", "MCPEnterprise",
                             Path has "/messages" or Path has "/mailfolders", "Mail",
                             Path has "/drive" or Path has "/drives", "Files",
                             Path has "/sites", "Sites",
                             Path has "/chats" or Path has "/channels", "Chat",
                             Path has "/users" or Path has "/groups", "Directory",
                             "Other")
    | where Category != "Other"
    | extend TargetUser = extract(@"/users/([^/]+)/", 1, Path);
let Baseline = SensitiveCalls
    | where TimeGenerated <= ago(recent)
    | summarize Hourly = count() by AppId, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
    | summarize AvgHourly = avg(Hourly), StdHourly = stdev(Hourly), BaselineHours = count() by AppId;
SensitiveCalls
| where TimeGenerated > ago(recent)
| summarize Requests = count(),
            BytesOut = sum(ResponseSizeBytes),
            DistinctTargetUsers = dcount(TargetUser),
            Categories = make_set(Category, 10),
            Methods = make_set(RequestMethod, 10),
            IPs = make_set(IPAddress, 20),
            SampleUris = make_set(RequestUri, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
         by AppId, ServicePrincipalId
| join kind=inner AgentApps on AppId
| join kind=leftouter Baseline on AppId
| extend Threshold = iff(isnull(AvgHourly), real(MinRequests), max_of(real(MinRequests), AvgHourly + SigmaThreshold * coalesce(StdHourly, 0.0)))
| where Requests > Threshold
| extend Severity = iff(Categories has_any ("Mail", "Files", "MCPEnterprise") and DistinctTargetUsers > 5, "High", "Medium")
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, AppName, AppId, ServicePrincipalId, AgentType, Requests, Threshold, AvgHourly, StdHourly,
          BytesOut, DistinctTargetUsers, Categories, Methods, IPs, SampleUris, Severity

properties.description: YumaAIA-D10-PromptInjectionThenExfiltration Analytics Rule with template version 1.0.0

Correlates Microsoft Defender XDR prompt-injection alerts or Copilot jailbreak events with exfiltration-like CloudAppEvents activity by the same user within two hours. Maps to ISM-2158, ISM-1924 and ISM-2113.
properties.displayName: Yuma AIA-D10 Prompt-injection or jailbreak alert followed by exfiltration activity
properties.query:
let lookback = 3h;
let window = 2h;
let MinExfilEvents = 10;
let ExfilActions = dynamic(["FileDownloaded", "FileSyncDownloadedFull", "FileCopied", "AnonymousLinkCreated",
    "AnonymousLinkUsed", "CompanyLinkCreated", "SharingSet", "SharingInvitationCreated", "AddedToSecureLink",
    "Send", "SendAs", "New-InboxRule", "Set-InboxRule", "UpdateInboxRules", "MailItemsAccessed"]);
let InjectionTitles = dynamic(["prompt injection", "jailbreak", "XPIA", "UPIA"]);
let DefenderTriggers = AlertInfo
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
    | where Title has_any (InjectionTitles)
    | join kind=inner (
        AlertEvidence
        | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
        | where EntityType =~ "User"
        | project AlertId, AccountObjectId, AccountUpn
      ) on AlertId
    | project TriggerTime = Timestamp, TriggerSource = strcat("Defender: ", Title), TriggerId = AlertId,
              AccountObjectId, AccountUpn;
let CopilotTriggers = CopilotActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where RecordType == "CopilotInteraction" and tostring(LLMEventData) has "JailbreakDetected"
    | project TriggerTime = TimeGenerated, TriggerSource = strcat("CopilotActivity jailbreak: ", AppHost),
              TriggerId = RecordId, AccountObjectId = ActorUserId, AccountUpn = ActorName;
let Triggers = union isfuzzy=true DefenderTriggers, CopilotTriggers
    | extend Keys = pack_array(tolower(AccountObjectId), tolower(AccountUpn))
    | mv-expand Key = Keys to typeof(string)
    | where isnotempty(Key);
let Activity = CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
    | where ActionType in (ExfilActions)
    | extend Keys = pack_array(tolower(AccountObjectId), tolower(tostring(RawEventData.UserId)))
    | mv-expand Key = Keys to typeof(string)
    | where isnotempty(Key)
    | project ActivityTime = Timestamp, Key, ActionType, Application, ObjectName, IPAddress, ReportId,
              ActivityAccountObjectId = AccountObjectId, ActivityAccountName = AccountDisplayName;
Triggers
| join kind=inner Activity on Key
| where ActivityTime between (TriggerTime .. (TriggerTime + window))
| summarize ExfilEvents = dcount(ReportId),
            Actions = make_set(ActionType, 20),
            Apps = make_set(Application, 10),
            SampleObjects = make_set(ObjectName, 20),
            IPs = make_set(IPAddress, 10),
            FirstActivity = min(ActivityTime), LastActivity = max(ActivityTime)
         by TriggerId, TriggerSource, TriggerTime, AccountUpn, AccountObjectId = ActivityAccountObjectId
| where ExfilEvents >= MinExfilEvents or Actions has_any ("AnonymousLinkCreated", "New-InboxRule", "Set-InboxRule")
| extend Severity = iff(Actions has_any ("AnonymousLinkCreated", "New-InboxRule", "Set-InboxRule"), "High", "Medium")
| project TriggerTime, TriggerSource, TriggerId, AccountUpn, AccountObjectId, ExfilEvents, Actions, Apps,
          SampleObjects, IPs, FirstActivity, LastActivity, Severity

properties.query:
let lookback = 1d;
let AIAgentUA = dynamic(["GPTBot", "ChatGPT-User", "OAI-SearchBot", "ClaudeBot", "Claude-User", "Claude-SearchBot",
    "PerplexityBot", "Perplexity-User", "Meta-ExternalAgent", "Bytespider", "CCBot", "Google-Extended"]);
let ProbePaths = dynamic(["/mcp", "/sse", "/.well-known/mcp", "/v1/chat/completions", "/v1/completions",
    "/api/generate", "/.well-known/ai-plugin.json", "/openapi.json", "/llms.txt"]);
AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| extend ClaimsAIAgent = UserAgent has_any (AIAgentUA),
         IsProbe = tolower(RequestUri) has_any (ProbePaths)
| where ClaimsAIAgent or IsProbe
| summarize Requests = count(), DistinctUris = dcount(RequestUri), NotFound = countif(HttpStatus == 404),
            ProbeHits = countif(IsProbe), UserAgents = make_set(UserAgent, 10), SampleUris = make_set(RequestUri, 20),
            Hosts = make_set(Host, 5), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
         by ClientIp, ClaimsAIAgent
| extend NotFoundRatio = round(todouble(NotFound) / Requests, 2)
| where ProbeHits > 0 or DistinctUris > 200 or NotFoundRatio > 0.5
| order by ProbeHits desc, DistinctUris desc

properties.description: YumaAIA-D15-AgenticMcpSensitivePrimitive Hunting Query with template version 1.0.0

properties.displayName: Yuma AIA-D15 Agentic traffic invoking sensitive MCP primitives or new destinations
properties.query:
let lookback = 1d;
let baseline = 14d;
let SensitiveVerbs = @"(?i)(delete|remove|drop|truncate|exec|execute|shell|run_command|send|transfer|payment|write|upload|share|grant)";
let Agentic = NetworkAccessTraffic
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(baseline)
    | where IsAgentic == true;
let KnownMcpDest = Agentic
    | where TimeGenerated <= ago(lookback) and isnotempty(McpProtocolVersion)
    | distinct AIAgentId, DestinationFqdn;
Agentic
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where isnotempty(McpPrimitiveName) or isnotempty(McpProtocolVersion)
| join kind=leftanti KnownMcpDest on AIAgentId, DestinationFqdn
| union (Agentic | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback) | where McpPrimitiveName matches regex SensitiveVerbs)

properties.query:

    "RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory", "User.ReadWrite.All", "Group.ReadWrite.All",

    "Sites.FullControl.All", "Chat.Read.All", "Chat.ReadWrite.All", "ChannelMessage.Read.All"]);
let ReviewCycle = 182d;   // ISM-2138: at least every six months
let Records = AIAgentRegister_CL;
let Snapshot = Records
    | where RecordType == "RegisterSnapshot"
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AgentName, Source, Platform, AppId, ServicePrincipalId, EntraAgentId,
                        EntraBlueprintId, Owners, BusinessPurpose, Identities, Permissions, DeclaredTools, McpServers,
                        DataSources, SharedWith, LifecycleStatus, RiskRating)
             by AgentKey
    | project-rename LastSnapshotAt = TimeGenerated;
let Decisions = Records
    | where RecordType == "ConsentDecision"
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Decision, DecisionBy, DecisionReason, ConsentType, IsAdminConsent, ConsentedBy,
                        ConsentDate, IncidentArmId)
             by AgentKey
    | project-rename LastDecisionAt = TimeGenerated;
let Lifecycle = Records
    | extend ReviewTime = iff(RecordType in ("ReviewCompleted", "ConsentDecision"), coalesce(LastReviewDate, TimeGenerated), datetime(null))
    | summarize FirstRecorded = min(TimeGenerated),

properties.query:
let Lookback = 30d;
let Reg = YumaAIRegister();
let RegTotal = toscalar(Reg | count);
let RegNoIdentity = toscalar(Reg | where Gap_NoUniqueIdentity | count);
let RegWithGaps = toscalar(Reg | where GapCount > 0 | count);
let RegReviewDue = toscalar(Reg | where ReviewStatus in ("Overdue", "Never reviewed") | count);
let RegHighRisk = toscalar(Reg | where Flag_HighRiskPermissions | count);
let RegLastWrite = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true (AIAgentRegister_CL | summarize t = max(TimeGenerated)), (print t = datetime(null)) | summarize max(t));
let YumaAlerts = union isfuzzy=true
        (SecurityAlert
         | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
         | where AlertName startswith "Yuma AIA-"
         | extend DetectionId = extract(@"Yuma AIA-(D\d+)", 1, AlertName)
         | summarize n = count() by DetectionId),
        (datatable(DetectionId:string, n:long)[]);
let AlertsFor = (id:string) { toscalar(YumaAlerts | where DetectionId == id | summarize tolong(sum(n))) };
let MsInjectionAlerts = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
        (SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback) | where AlertName has_any ("prompt injection", "jailbreak") | summarize n = count()),
        (print n = tolong(0)) | summarize sum(n));
let UserConsents = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
        (AuditLogs
         | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
         | where OperationName =~ "Consent to application" and Result =~ "success"
         | mv-expand TargetResource = TargetResources
         | mv-expand Prop = TargetResource.modifiedProperties
         | where tostring(Prop.displayName) == "ConsentContext.IsAdminConsent" and tostring(Prop.newValue) has "False"
         | summarize n = dcount(CorrelationId)),
        (print n = tolong(0)) | summarize sum(n));
let AuditRows = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true (AuditLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) | summarize n = count()), (print n = tolong(0)) | summarize sum(n));
let SpSignInRows = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true (AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) | summarize n = count()), (print n = tolong(0)) | summarize sum(n));
let GraphRows = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true (MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) | summarize n = count()), (print n = tolong(0)) | summarize sum(n));
let AgenticNetRows = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true (NetworkAccessTraffic | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) and IsAgentic == true | summarize n = count()), (print n = tolong(0)) | summarize sum(n));
let CopilotRows = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true (CopilotActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) | summarize n = count()), (print n = tolong(0)) | summarize sum(n));
let SigninRows = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true (SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) | summarize n = count()), (print n = tolong(0)) | summarize sum(n));
let DeviceCode = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
        (SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback) and AuthenticationProtocol =~ "deviceCode" | summarize n = count()),
        (print n = tolong(0)) | summarize sum(n));
let DeviceCodeUsers = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
        (SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback) and AuthenticationProtocol =~ "deviceCode" | summarize n = dcount(UserPrincipalName)),
        (print n = tolong(0)) | summarize sum(n));
let AgentCA = union isfuzzy=true
        (AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
         | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
         | extend AgentType = tostring(parse_json(Agent).agentType)
         | where isnotempty(AgentType) and AgentType !~ "notAgentic"
         | summarize Total = count(), NotApplied = countif(ConditionalAccessStatus =~ "notApplied")),
        (datatable(Total:long, NotApplied:long)[]);
let AgentSignIns = toscalar(AgentCA | summarize tolong(sum(Total)));
let AgentNoCA = toscalar(AgentCA | summarize tolong(sum(NotApplied)));
let Rows = union
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2133",
           Status = case(RegTotal == 0, "No data", RegNoIdentity == 0, "Evidence present", "Gap"),
           Metric = strcat(RegNoIdentity, " of ", RegTotal, " registered agents have no unique Entra identity"),
           AlertsLookback = coalesce(AlertsFor("D07"), 0)),
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2134",
           Status = case(isnull(RegLastWrite), "No data", RegLastWrite > ago(7d), "Evidence present", "Gap"),
           Metric = strcat("Register last written ", format_datetime(RegLastWrite, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"), " UTC; ", RegTotal, " active agents"),
           AlertsLookback = tolong(0)),
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2135",
           Status = case(RegTotal == 0, "No data", RegWithGaps == 0, "Evidence present", "Gap"),
           Metric = strcat(RegWithGaps, " of ", RegTotal, " agents missing owner, purpose, identity or permissions"),
           AlertsLookback = tolong(0)),
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2136",
           Status = case(coalesce(AgentSignIns, 0) == 0, "No data", "Attestation required"),
           Metric = strcat(coalesce(AgentNoCA, 0), " of ", coalesce(AgentSignIns, 0), " agentic service principal sign-ins had no Conditional Access applied (30d)"),
           AlertsLookback = coalesce(AlertsFor("D07"), 0)),
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2137",
           Status = case(AuditRows == 0, "No data", UserConsents == 0, "Evidence present", "Gap"),
           Metric = strcat(UserConsents, " user (non-admin) app consents in 90 days"),
           AlertsLookback = coalesce(AlertsFor("D05"), 0)),
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2138",
           Status = case(RegTotal == 0, "No data", RegReviewDue == 0, "Evidence present", "Gap"),
           Metric = strcat(RegReviewDue, " of ", RegTotal, " agents overdue or never reviewed (6-month cycle)"),
           AlertsLookback = tolong(0)),
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2139",
           Status = case(AuditRows > 0 and SpSignInRows > 0 and GraphRows > 0, "Evidence present", AuditRows > 0, "Gap", "No data"),
           Metric = strcat("Last 24h rows: AuditLogs ", AuditRows, "; service principal sign-ins ", SpSignInRows, "; Graph activity ", GraphRows),
           AlertsLookback = tolong(0)),
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2140",
           Status = case(SigninRows == 0, "No data", DeviceCode == 0, "Evidence present", "Gap"),
           Metric = strcat(DeviceCode, " device code sign-ins by ", DeviceCodeUsers, " users in 30 days"),
           AlertsLookback = tolong(0)),
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2156",
           Status = case(RegTotal == 0, "No data", RegHighRisk == 0, "Evidence present", "Attestation required"),
           Metric = strcat(RegHighRisk, " agents hold high-risk permissions; justify each or reduce"),
           AlertsLookback = coalesce(AlertsFor("D04"), 0)),
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2157",
           Status = "Attestation required",
           Metric = strcat(coalesce(AlertsFor("D08"), 0), " agent Graph data-burst alerts in 30 days"),
           AlertsLookback = coalesce(AlertsFor("D08"), 0)),
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2158",
           Status = "Attestation required",
           Metric = strcat(MsInjectionAlerts, " prompt-injection or jailbreak alerts; ", coalesce(AlertsFor("D10"), 0), " followed by exfil-like activity (30d)"),
           AlertsLookback = coalesce(AlertsFor("D10"), 0)),
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2159",
           Status = case(GraphRows > 0 and (AgenticNetRows > 0 or CopilotRows > 0), "Evidence present", GraphRows > 0 or AgenticNetRows > 0 or CopilotRows > 0, "Gap", "No data"),
           Metric = strcat("Last 24h rows: Graph activity ", GraphRows, "; GSA agentic traffic ", AgenticNetRows, "; CopilotActivity ", CopilotRows),
           AlertsLookback = coalesce(AlertsFor("D15"), 0));
Rows
| join kind=leftouter (_GetWatchlist("YumaISMControlMap") | project ControlId, Control, Theme, PackEvidence, EvidenceMethod) on ControlId
| project-away ControlId1
| extend CheckedAtUtc = now()
| project ControlId, Theme, Control, Status, Metric, AlertsLookback, PackEvidence, EvidenceMethod, CheckedAtUtc
| order by ControlId asc

properties.descriptionHtml:
The Yuma AI Agent Threat Detection solution for Microsoft Sentinel packages analytics rules, hunting queries, an AI agent register and ISM evidence workbook, saved workspace functions (parsers), and Logic App playbooks to detect and investigate risky AI and agent activity across Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, Defender XDR, Global Secure Access and Azure Application Gateway WAF. All analytics rules and playbooks deploy disabled so security teams can tune thresholds in a test workspace before enabling them.

Prerequisite: Prerequisite: deploy microsoft/deploy/register-infra.json (or the unified microsoft/deploy/azuredeploy.json) into the target workspace first to create AIAgentRegister_CL, the direct-ingestion DCR and the YumaAIRegisterApproved and YumaISMControlMap watchlists.
